abilities.name: Critical Mass
abilities.text: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.

abilities.name: Magic Missiles
abilities.text: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147 damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.text: Fire an Orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135 damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the further it travels, up to 270 more damage.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.text: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

abilities.name: Wave of Force
abilities.text: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 damage.

1.name: Force Armor
1.text:
When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.

Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

1.name: Aether Walker
1.text: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

1.name: Power Hungry
1.text: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

4.name: Charged Blast
4.text: Basic Attacking a target recently hit by a Magic Missile does an extra 87 damage.

4.name: Triumvirate
4.text: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

4.name: Dominance
4.text: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

7.name: Seeker
7.text: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140 damage.

7.name: Zei's Vengeance
7.text: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

7.name: Calamity
7.text: Teleport does 300 damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

10.name: Disintegrate
10.text: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

10.name: Wave of Force
10.text: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 damage.

13.name: Illusionist
13.text:
If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

13.name: Cannoneer
13.text: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical. Stacks up to 3 times.

13.name: Glass Cannon
13.text: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

16.name: Fireflies
16.text: Drastically increases Magic Missiles speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is reduced by 5.

16.name: Mirrorball
16.text: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

16.name: Arcane Orbit
16.text: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 to 371.

16.name: Diamond Skin
16.text: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

20.name: Temporal Flux
20.text: Disintegrate gradually Slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

20.name: Repulsion
20.text: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.

20.name: Tal Rasha's Elements
20.text: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%. This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

20.name: Archon: Pure Power
20.text: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.
